units.source_text: 此时明石夫人陪着女御住在东南院。

en.t: At this time Lady Akashi was staying in the southeast wing, attending the Nyogo.

units.source_text: 老尼姑派人去通报她，说明石浦上送来了这样的信。

en.t: The old nun sent someone to notify her, saying that such a letter had arrived from Akashi Bay.

units.source_text: 明石夫人便悄悄地回西北院来。

en.t: Lady Akashi then quietly returned to the northwest wing.

units.source_text: 明石夫人现在身份尊贵，非有重要事情，难得和老尼姑往来。

en.t: Lady Akashi was now of exalted rank, and unless there was important business, she rarely had occasion to visit the old nun.

units.source_text: 现在听说有可悲的事，甚是担心，所以立刻悄悄地来了。

en.t: Now, hearing that there was sorrowful news, she became deeply worried and came at once in secret.

units.source_text: 走进室内，看见老尼姑神情异常悲伤。

en.t: When she entered the room, she saw that the old nun looked unusually grief-stricken.

units.source_text: 她走近灯前，读了明石道人的信，眼泪流个不住。

en.t: She went near the lamp, read the letter from the Akashi Novice, and could not stop her tears from flowing.

units.source_text: 在别人看来，此乃无足轻重之事。

en.t: To others, this would have seemed a matter of little consequence.

units.source_text: 但明石夫人回思昔年父女之情，心中不胜依恋。

en.t: But as Lady Akashi recalled the affection between father and daughter in former years, her heart was overcome with longing.

units.source_text: 想起永别慈父，今后不得再见，便觉伤心之极，无可奈何了。

en.t: Thinking that she was parting forever from her loving father and would never see him again, she felt unbearably sad and utterly helpless.

units.source_text: 她一面流泪不止，一面看见父亲信中所说的梦，庆喜自己前程有望。

en.t: While her tears continued to fall, she read of the dream mentioned in her father's letter and rejoiced that her own future held promise.

units.source_text: 她想：“如此说来，昔年父亲固执己见，强把我嫁与身份不相称之人，几乎误我终身，使我一时心迷意乱，原来是凭仗这个无据之梦，而怀抱着高飞远举之志！”

en.t: She thought, "So that was it: years ago my father clung stubbornly to his own view and forced me to marry a man whose rank did not match mine, nearly ruining my whole life and throwing me into confusion for a time, all because he relied on this baseless dream and cherished ambitions for me to rise far above my station!"

units.source_text: 此时她才恍然大悟。

en.t: Only then did she suddenly understand.

units.source_text: 老尼姑踌躇良久，才对她说道：“我托你的福，坐享荣华，面目增光，幸运实已过分，然而悲哀与忧患亦比常人加倍。

en.t: After hesitating for a long while, the old nun said to her, "Thanks to your good fortune, I have enjoyed glory and honor, and my reputation has been brightened; my luck has truly been excessive, yet my sorrow and anxiety are also twice those of ordinary people.

units.source_text: 我虽是微不足数之人，然而舍弃了久已住惯的京都而沉沦在荒僻的浦上，已觉得是异乎常人的苦命了。

en.t: Though I am a person of no account, I already felt that abandoning Kyoto, where I had long been used to living, and sinking into hardship on a desolate shore was a fate more bitter than most.

units.source_text: 我与汝父同生此世，但别室而居，夫妇乖隔。

en.t: Your father and I were born into the same world, yet we lived in separate rooms, estranged as husband and wife.

units.source_text: 然而我并不介意，但望他日同生极乐世界，再结后世之缘。

en.t: Yet I did not mind it, and only hoped that one day we would be born together in the Pure Land and renew our bond in a future life.

units.source_text: 岂料蛰居多年之后，你忽然离乡入京，我又随你重返当年背弃的京都。

en.t: Who could have expected that, after so many years in seclusion, you would suddenly leave home for the capital, and I would follow you back to the Kyoto I had once abandoned.

units.source_text: 眼看你等荣华富贵，无任欣慰。

en.t: Seeing you all enjoy glory, wealth, and rank has comforted me beyond measure.

units.source_text: 然而遥念家乡，又时时牵挂，不绝添愁。

en.t: Yet whenever I thought of our distant home, I remained constantly anxious, and my sorrow only grew.

units.source_text: 终于不能再见汝父，此生遂成永诀，真乃遗憾之事！

en.t: In the end I could not see your father again, and in this life our parting has become final; it is truly a matter of deep regret!

units.source_text: 汝父未出家时，性情本已异乎常人，颇有愤世嫉俗之概。

en.t: Before your father took holy orders, his nature was already unlike that of ordinary people, and he had a strong air of bitterness toward the world and its ways.

units.source_text: 但与我从小意气相投，情谊之厚无比，彼此信赖甚深。

en.t: But from childhood he and I were of one mind, our affection was incomparably deep, and we trusted each other profoundly.

units.source_text: 何以居处相去不远，而一旦忽成永别呢？”

en.t: How could we live not so very far apart, and yet suddenly be separated forever?"

units.source_text: 她继续诉说，样子非常悲恸。

en.t: She went on speaking, and her manner was filled with grief.

units.source_text: 明石夫人也哭得很伤心。

en.t: Lady Akashi too wept in great sorrow.

units.source_text: 她说：“我的前程虽说比别人远大，但我并不引为荣幸。

en.t: She said, "Though my future may be greater than that of others, I do not count it as an honor.

units.source_text: 像我这微不足数之身，终无显贵之望。

en.t: For someone as insignificant as I am, there can be no real hope of high distinction.

units.source_text: 今又身逢悲痛之事，从此不能与父亲再见，真乃抱恨无穷！

en.t: Now this sorrowful event has befallen me, and from this point on I cannot see my father again; truly, my regret will be endless!

units.source_text: 我年来一举一动，无非为了欲慰亲心。

en.t: Every action I have taken over the years has been solely for the sake of comforting my parents' hearts.

units.source_text: 今老父闭居深山之中，世事无常，一旦天年消尽，我这用心都是徒然的了！”

en.t: Now my aged father lives shut away deep in the mountains, and since the world is impermanent, once his allotted life is spent, all my efforts will have been in vain!"

units.source_text: 是夜母女两人共诉愁情，直到天明。

en.t: That night, mother and daughter shared their sorrows with each other until dawn.

units.source_text: 明石夫人说：“昨日六条院主君看见我住在那边，今日忽然不见，未免怪我轻率。

en.t: Lady Akashi said, "Yesterday the lord of Rokujo saw me staying over there; if I suddenly disappear today, he may well think me careless.

units.source_text: 我自身绝无顾虑，但恐有伤女御体面，所以不敢任意行动。”

en.t: I myself have no concern at all, but I fear harming the Nyogo's dignity, and so I dare not act as I please."

units.source_text: 便决定在天色向晓之时回东南院去。

en.t: So she decided to return to the southeast wing when the sky began to brighten toward dawn.

units.source_text: 临行老尼姑对她说道：“小皇子近来如何？

en.t: As she was leaving, the old nun said to her, "How has the little prince been lately?

units.source_text: 我很想看看他呢。”

en.t: I very much want to see him."

units.source_text: 说着又哭起来。

en.t: As she said this, she began to cry again.

units.source_text: 明石夫人答道：“不久你就会看到他的。

en.t: Lady Akashi replied, "Before long you will be able to see him.

units.source_text: 女御对你非常亲爱，常在说起你呢。

en.t: The Nyogo is very fond of you and often speaks of you.

units.source_text: 主君也在谈话中说起你，他说：‘我要说句不吉祥的预言：如果换了朝代，小皇子果然做了皇太子，希望那时候老尼姑长生在世才好。’

en.t: The lord also mentioned you in conversation, saying, 'I will make an inauspicious prediction: if the reign changes and the little prince truly becomes crown prince, I hope the old nun will still be alive then.'

units.source_text: 大概他心中有什么计划吧。”

en.t: He probably has some plan in mind."

units.source_text: 老尼姑听了这话立刻破涕为笑，说道：“哎呀，如此说来，我的命运真是优越无比的了！”

en.t: When the old nun heard this, she immediately smiled through her tears and said, "Oh my, if that is so, then my fate is truly beyond compare!"

units.source_text: 就不胜欣喜。

en.t: She was overcome with joy.

units.source_text: 明石夫人便带了道人送来的文件箱子回去了。

en.t: Lady Akashi then took the document box sent by the Novice and went back.
